observations_to_reconcile.what: Three mutually inconsistent durations for the same single room in one persisted learning record
observations_to_reconcile.detail: room_timings[0] cleaning_start 03:00:38 -> cleaning_end 03:01:38 gives cleaning_wall_seconds=60, which matches the timestamps. But cleaning_seconds=90 on the same entry (1.5x), and the job-level room_cleaning_minutes=0.34 (20.4s) matches neither - it is derived as actual_cleaning_minutes 2.38 minus return_to_dock_minutes 2.04.
observations_to_reconcile.why_it_matters: Learning consumes these fields. A single room clean should not produce 60s, 90s and 20s as three answers to the same question.
